newsitem.title: USA: Smith Barney expands European research.
newsitem.headline: Smith Barney expands European research.

text.p: Smith Barney Inc said Thursday that four European equity teams will join its London office from Dillon, Read Securities Ltd on September 1.
Smith Barney said the teams, which total 18 professionals, specialize in research, sales and trading for Belgian, French, German and Spanish equities.

Smith Barney said Jason Maude, head of the European equity teams, and Sebastian Scotney, deputy head, will join the firm from Dillon, Read as managing directors. The executives will be responsible for managing and expanding the European equity sales and research operation in London.
Smith Barney said as part of the expansion it will open a Frankfurt office headed by Barbara Haas, who also is joining the firm from Dillon, Read.
A spokeman for Dillon Read in New York was not immediately available for comment.
Swiss Bank Corp is expected to close on its acquisition of Dillon Read sometime in September. The transaction received approval from the Federal Reserve board earlier this week.
An industry source said that given the overlap in Europe between Swiss Bank Corp and Dillon Read, some departures were expected.
Smith Barney is a unit of Travelers Group Inc.
